{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove commas from revenue and convert to float
completed_data['revenue_clean'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the sentinel value '999999.99' in cleaned revenue
sentinel_mask = (completed_data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
sentinel_count = sentinel_mask.sum()

# If any sentinel values exist, remove them
if sentinel_count > 0:
    print(f"Found {sentinel_count} sentinel values (999999.99). Removing them.")
    completed_data = completed_data[~sentinel_mask]

# Recompute mean revenue after removing sentinels
mean_revenue = completed_data['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the final result
print(mean_revenue)"}
